player_prompt.intro:
Kamuyki Pukara {player_id} Negosiasyun P'ukllaypi.
Juk ruwaykikunayki, ichaqa sut'iyki ruwaykikunata q'umirichiy atinikunapaq.
Ruwaykikuna ichaqa allin ruwaykikunayki kan: 
	+ {resource_value_list}
Huk p'unchaypi, ripusqaykipas willakun, ruwachiy atinkichik.
Uyariykuhina wakichiwan: 
  - '[Offer: 3 Ullu, 2 Q'illu -> 5 T'ika, 2 Ullu]': [Offer: Q'umirichisqa Ruwaykuna -> Mañakusqa Ruwaykuna]
  - '[Accept]': Manaraq ruwasqanmanta q'umiriy.
  - '[Deny]': Manam ruwasqanmanta ñawiy (urin ruwana).
Huk p'ukllayqa {max_turns} p'unchaykunatam purin.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Player tried accepting a trade without having the necessary resources.

invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Player {player_id} tried to make a trade offer without having the necessary resources.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Chaypi nin: "Player {player_id} nisqa, mana allin formata churarqa.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Chaypi, {player_id} nisqaqa mana musuq rantikuyta ruwarqanchu.
